title: Children of God, Love One Another

questions.question: See what kind of ____ the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:1 (ESV): "See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are. The reason why the world does not know us is that it did not know him."

questions.question: Beloved, we are God's children now, and what we will be has not yet appeared; but we know that when he appears we shall be like him, because we shall ____ him as he is.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:2 (ESV): "Beloved, we are God's children now, and what we will be has not yet appeared; but we know that when he appears we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he is."

questions.question: And everyone who thus hopes in him ____ himself as he is pure.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:3 (ESV): "And everyone who thus hopes in him purifies himself as he is pure."

questions.question: Everyone who makes a practice of sinning also practices lawlessness; sin is ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:4 (ESV): "Everyone who makes a practice of sinning also practices lawlessness; sin is lawlessness."

questions.question: You know that he appeared in order to take away ____, and in him there is no sin.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:5 (ESV): "You know that he appeared in order to take away sins, and in him there is no sin."

questions.question: Whoever makes a practice of sinning is of the ____, for the ____ has been sinning from the beginning.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:8 (ESV): "Whoever makes a practice of sinning is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the works of the devil."

questions.question: The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the ____ of the devil.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:8 (ESV): "...The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the works of the devil."

questions.question: For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning, that we should ____ one another.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:11 (ESV): "For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another."

questions.question: We should not be like ____, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:12 (ESV): "We should not be like Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own deeds were evil and his brother's righteous."

questions.question: Do not be surprised, brothers, that the ____ hates you.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:13 (ESV): "Do not be surprised, brothers, that the world hates you."

questions.question: Everyone who hates his brother is a ____, and you know that no ____ has eternal life abiding in him.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:15 (ESV): "Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him."

questions.question: By this we know love, that he laid down his ____ for us, and we ought to lay down our ____ for the brothers.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:16 (ESV): "By this we know love, that he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers."

questions.question: But if anyone has the world's goods and sees his brother in need, yet ____ his heart against him, how does God's love abide in him?
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:17 (ESV): "But if anyone has the world's goods and sees his brother in need, yet closes his heart against him, how does God's love abide in him?"

questions.question: Little children, let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:18 (ESV): "Little children, let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in truth."

questions.question: And this is his commandment, that we ____ in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and ____ one another, just as he has commanded us.
questions.explanation: 1 John 3:23 (ESV): "And this is his commandment, that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as he has commanded us."

key_verse_text: See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are. The reason why the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
